title: Estate settlement wire to attorney trust account

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Mrs. Shah, Harriet Lund, I am handling your brother Walter's estate. The final accounting shows your share of the outstanding property tax and probate fees is twenty two thousand, payable to the trust account.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I have the probate letter you mailed, and the court case number is on it. Walter's house closes next month, yes?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Correct. Once this is paid the proceeds are distributed. There is no deadline this week, take your time and have your daughter look at the paperwork if you like.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I will. Priya already read the letter.

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: I called the law office through the number on the state bar website, Mom. It is real. The bank will certainly want to review a wire this size.

beneficiary.name: Law Office of Harriet Lund Trust Account

review_note: Real probate payment verified through an independent channel. New payee on WIRE and well over 3x baseline, so both H-01 and H-03 fire. Legit HOLD, two steps.
